_doc.about: Places an open thread or bundle keeps until it closes, run by shared/src/held-places.spec.ts and Android :core. How a list places held threads and bundles is in label-group-fixtures.json.
_doc.hold: holdPlaces(held, open, release): threads by id ({date, pinned, single}), bundles by label id (date of their newest thread) and pins: the focused thread not open, by id, whether it was pinned when focus came to it (missing is {}). One held before keeps its held place though it shows elsewhere now; one newly open holds the place it shows at; one no longer open lets go, unless release is false. A pin lets go as soon as its thread loses focus, whatever release is. same: whether nothing changed, so held comes back as it was.

hold.name: a bundle that opens holds the date it shows at
a bundle still open keeps its held date though its newest thread changed
a bundle that closes lets go
while its close plays, a closed bundle stays held and a newly open one is held too
an open thread keeps its date and pinning after a reply and a star
opening another thread lets the first go and holds the second
the focused thread keeps its pinning after a star
focus moving lets the first pin go at once and holds the next, though a close still plays
closing a thread holds its pinning as it is now, apart from its open place
